description: This file implements a 1MHz microsecond timer for event scheduling on embedded hardware, including setup, control, and callback mechanisms, as well as a watchdog to monitor timer activity.

classes.name: MicrosecondTimerWatchdogController
classes.description: A periodic controller class that monitors the activity of the microsecond timer to detect stalls or inactivity.

methods.name: setHardwareUsTimer
methods.description: Configures the hardware timer to trigger an event after a specified number of microseconds.

methods.name: initMicrosecondTimer
methods.description: Initializes and starts the hardware timer with predefined configuration.
